sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.PATIENT) FROM patients T1 JOIN immunizations T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.first='Keven' AND T1.last='Kuhn' AND T2.DESCRIPTION='DTaP'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.first, T1.last FROM patients T1 JOIN medications T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION='Clopidogrel 75 MG Oral Tablet' AND strftime('%Y',T2.STOP)-strftime('%Y',T2.START)>10
SELECT T1."PREVALENCE RATE" FROM all_prevalences T1 JOIN conditions T2 ON lower(T1.ITEM)=lower(T2.DESCRIPTION) WHERE T2.START='2014-05-09'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.DESCRIPTION='Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T2.PATIENT), SUM(CASE WHEN T2.DESCRIPTION='Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' AND T1.ethnicity='english' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM patients T1 JOIN immunizations T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT WHERE strftime('%Y',T2.DATE)='2017'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.patient) FROM patients T1 JOIN medications T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.STOP IS NOT NULL AND T1.deathdate IS NULL AND T2.REASONDESCRIPTION='Coronary Heart Disease'

SELECT T2.DESCRIPTION, T3.DESCRIPTION, T4.DESCRIPTION, T1.first, T1.last FROM patients T1 JOIN careplans T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT JOIN procedures T3 ON T1.patient=T3.PATIENT JOIN medications T4 ON T1.patient=T4.PATIENT WHERE T2.ENCOUNTER='6f2e3935-b203-493e-a9c0-f23e847b9798'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND((strftime('%J',T2.DATE)-strftime('%J',T1.birthdate))/365) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN T2.VALUE ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(CASE WHEN ROUND((strftime('%J',T2.DATE)-strftime('%J',T1.birthdate))/365) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN T2.PATIENT END) - SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND((strftime('%J',T2.DATE)-strftime('%J',T1.birthdate))/365) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN T2.VALUE ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(CASE WHEN ROUND((strftime('%J',T2.DATE)-strftime('%J',T1.birthdate))/365) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN T2.PATIENT END) FROM patients T1 JOIN observations T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION='Glucose'
SELECT T2.DESCRIPTION FROM patients T1 JOIN conditions T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.first='Joye' AND T1.last='Homenick' AND strftime('%Y',T2.START)='2017'

SELECT MAX(T2.DATE) FROM patients T1 JOIN immunizations T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.first='Joye' AND T1.last='Homenick' AND T2.DESCRIPTION='Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free'
